source_architecture_observation: Frozen Stage-2 build_model repeats the raw p_vec across sequence nodes and concatenates it directly with xi before the LSTM. Nc is the 11th/final conditioner. No explicit conditioner normalization is present in build_model.
scientific_interpretation: Increasing training duration from 400 to 800 epochs improved absolute accuracy but did not remove the relative high-Nc weakness. Undertraining alone is therefore not a sufficient explanation. A plausible next hypothesis is unfavorable Nc input scaling in the raw conditioner; this remains a hypothesis, not a conclusion.
not_concluded: Nc input scaling is definitely the root cause
the Stage-2 PDE residual is wrong
